title: $L^2$ Curvature Bounds on Ricci flows with bounded scalar curvature up to dimension 7
summary: In this paper, we study Ricci flows with uniformly bounded scalar curvature. On such Ricci flows we establish uniform $L^2$ Riemannian curvature bounds and $L^4$ Ricci curvature bounds up to dimension 7. These estimates improves $L^{2-\varepsilon}$ curvature bounds established by Bamler and $L^2$ curvature bounds in dimension 4 established by Bamler and Zhang. More generally, we establish uniform $L^2$ curvature bounds on $n$-manifolds satisfying an integral $L^p$ Ricci curvature bound for $p> n/2$, a uniform volume lower bound, and a strong $\varepsilon$-regularity assumption.
